exposure: Hemophilia A or B carrier status
cohort: 12 pregnant women (2 with mild hemophilia A, 2 with mild hemophilia B, 6 hemophilia A carriers, and 2 hemophilia B carriers) followed at a hemophilia treatment center
finding: In this case series, pregnant women with mild hemophilia or who were hemophilia carriers experienced successful outcomes with a multidisciplinary management approach.
mod_finding: Of the 18 pregnancies, 8 (44.4%) were vaginal deliveries and 10 (55.6%) were Cesarean sections.
